title: Add Polli privacy policy and terms
author: ElliotEtag
pr_body_excerpt:
- Adds Itachi’s complete Polli privacy policy to the existing /privacy document.
- Adds Itachi’s complete Polli terms to the existing /terms document.
- Keeps both policies published within the canonical Pollinations legal pages.
- Credits @Itachi-1824 for the policy text.
- Do not merge until @ElliotEtag verifies the review findings.

gist.headline: Polli Gets House Rules
gist.blurb: Polli’s legal nest has been properly furnished. The canonical privacy and terms pages now carry complete policy text, with a well-earned credit to @Itachi-1824.
gist.summary: Expanded the canonical /privacy and /terms legal pages with complete Polli privacy-policy and terms-of-service text, credited to @Itachi-1824.
gist.impact: Visitors can now find fuller, clearly published Polli privacy and service terms directly at the existing Pollinations legal URLs.
gist.visual_concept: Depict Polli as a careful little librarian or legal clerk placing two clearly labeled policy scrolls, Privacy and Terms, into a cozy garden-library bookshelf. The documents should feel welcoming rather than stern, surrounded by flowers, code-plants, and a softly glowing retro terminal representing the canonical legal pages.
gist.image_prompt: Cozy pixel art scene of the cute Polli bee mascot wearing tiny librarian glasses and a little lavender scarf, carefully shelving two friendly scrolls labeled “PRIVACY” and “TERMS” in a warm garden library beside a softly glowing retro terminal. Lime green (#ecf874) book spines and code-plants bloom among pastel flowers; cozy pixel art, 8-bit aesthetic, soft pastel gradients, warm lighting, retro gaming vibes, nostalgic but beautiful.
